downstream_consumers: RAG indexing, search, and answer generation
multi-index query consumers and diagnostic readers

risks.title: Upstream element identity changes invalidate downstream relationship assumptions
risks.mitigation: Complete and review Phase 1 before authoring the tree-sitter relationship phase.

risks.title: Low graph resolution can make dependency absence look authoritative
risks.mitigation: Use direct imports, targeted rg, and tests for load-bearing negative conclusions.

risks.title: Vector-store mutation can diverge from durable state on persistence failure
risks.mitigation: Make Phase 4 rollback-safe and add forced-write-failure tests before ranking work.

risks.title: Deferred phase plans can go stale if authored early
risks.mitigation: Retain STOP placeholders and run fresh discovery after each predecessor review.

decision_records.decision: Use one ticket-linked stub per rolling phase.
decision_records.rationale: It preserves ticket ownership and lets each next-phase plan consume fresh predecessor evidence.
The scanner directly instantiates and consumes ElementExtractor, so relationship fixes need stable upstream element identity and cardinality.

decision_records.decision: Place test and telemetry hygiene after runtime correctness.
decision_records.rationale: The stale CLI parser test and diagnostic metrics do not corrupt persisted graph or vector facts.
